newForms.name: Quipfin
newForms.lore: Its stripes rearrange themselves whenever it thinks of a better punchline.

newForms.name: Harlequill
newForms.lore: Wears a fin like a jester's cap and absolutely will not explain the joke.

newForms.name: Masquerfin
newForms.lore: Every mask it grows is a different joke; the reef keeps score.

newForms.name: Harlequeen
newForms.lore: Crowns itself ringmaster of the reef and, frankly, the reef agrees.

newForms.name: Sabrefin
newForms.lore: Practices its lunge on passing shadows and has never once missed.

newForms.name: Rapierjaw
newForms.lore: Its blade-nose can part a current in two clean halves.

newForms.name: Bladewake
newForms.lore: Leaves a wake shaped like a fencer's flourish, bow included.

newForms.name: Tidelance
newForms.lore: The undisputed champion of the reef's oldest duelling ground; nothing has beaten it twice.

newForms.name: Inkdrift
newForms.lore: Writes longer poems now; the tide erases them just as fast.

newForms.name: Versewhirl
newForms.lore: Its ink-clouds curl into shapes that almost look like words.

newForms.name: Sonnetide
newForms.lore: Scholars swear its ink-trails scan like verse, if you squint at low tide.

newForms.name: Inkmuse
newForms.lore: Every poet on the coast claims it whispered their best line first.

newForms.name: Thicketbuck
newForms.lore: Whole thickets take root in its antlers before it even notices.

newForms.name: Grovemonarch
newForms.lore: Younger deer bow when it passes; the moss on its antlers is older than the trail.

newForms.name: Canopyheart
newForms.lore: Its antlers have become the forest's own canopy; birds nest there and never leave.

newForms.name: Bristlemane
newForms.lore: Its mane has gone to thorns; cub and stranger alike learn to knock before visiting.

newForms.name: Duskbramble
newForms.lore: Leads the pack out at first dusk and nothing in the thicket argues.

newForms.name: Nightbriar
newForms.lore: The whole forest goes quiet when it walks; even the thorns seem to lean out of its way.

newForms.name: Brandfox
newForms.lore: Carries a coal in its chest that never quite goes out, even in the rain.

newForms.name: Pyrevane
newForms.lore: Turns to face the wind before it turns to face you; the flame decides first.

newForms.name: Beaconpyre
newForms.lore: Wayfarers say its tail-flame burns brighter the more lost you are.

newForms.name: Beaconsire
newForms.lore: The old guide-light of the Elderwood; every lost path finds its way back through it eventually.

newForms.name: Lorewing
newForms.lore: Has opinions about every scroll in Elderhollow and shares them, unsolicited, at 3am.

newForms.name: Duskscholar
newForms.lore: Keeps a library in the hollow of an old oak and lends books it fully expects back.

newForms.name: Archowl
newForms.lore: Footnotes its own hoots. Nobody has ever asked it to stop.

newForms.name: Archsage
newForms.lore: The Elderwood's oldest living index; ask it anything and wait for the very long answer.

newForms.name: Cairnback
newForms.lore: Small stones stack themselves on its shoulders overnight; it never seems to mind.

newForms.name: Boulderoot
newForms.lore: Roots have grown clean through it and out the other side, and it calls them ribs now.

newForms.name: Mossmonolith
newForms.lore: Hikers use it as a landmark. It has learned to hold very, very still for photographs.

newForms.name: Cairnsovereign
newForms.lore: The oldest boundary marker in the Elderwood, older than the borders it once marked.

prompts.name: Jestfin
prompts.prompt: A small round clownfish in bold orange-and-white bands with a mischievous gap-toothed grin, translucent frilled fins flicking like a jester's sleeves.

prompts.name: Quipfin
prompts.prompt: A slightly bigger clownfish whose fin-frills have grown into a ruffled collar of orange and cream, with one eye perpetually mid-wink.

prompts.name: Harlequill
prompts.prompt: Its collar has become a proper diamond-patterned jester ruff in orange, cream and a new deep sapphire-violet tint, with long quill-like dorsal spines that wiggle when it laughs.

prompts.name: Masquerfin
prompts.prompt: A showy carnival fish trailing ribbon-fins in violet and gold, a painted mask-pattern spreading across its face in the same orange-and-cream bands as ever, only bolder.

prompts.name: Harlequeen
prompts.prompt: A resplendent reef monarch crowned in flowing magenta-and-gold ribbon fins shaped like a jester's crown, its original orange-and-cream bands now glowing faintly gold along every seam.

prompts.name: Lancefin
prompts.prompt: A sleek cobalt-blue swordfish with a long silver rostrum blade and a proud, focused stare, dorsal fin raised like a raised visor.

prompts.name: Sabrefin
prompts.prompt: A leaner, longer swordfish in deepening blue, its rostrum now a proper twin-edged sabre and its dorsal fin fanned like a cape.

prompts.name: Rapierjaw
prompts.prompt: Darker indigo-blue plating along its spine, a needle-fine rostrum held forward like a fencer's rapier, fins trimmed sharp and precise.

prompts.name: Bladewake
prompts.prompt: A long, powerful duelist in near-navy blue with faint steel highlights, its wake curling into blade-shaped ripples behind it.

prompts.name: Tidelance
prompts.prompt: A midnight-blue champion swordfish crowned in a faint silver-blue glow along every fin edge, its rostrum gleaming like a legendary blade held high.

prompts.name: Inkwhirl
prompts.prompt: A dusky violet octopus-like Mystic with long curling tentacles arranged in elegant loops, faint constellations of ink-dot freckles across its mantle.

prompts.name: Inkdrift
prompts.prompt: A larger tentacled Mystic in deepening violet, its ink trails drifting into soft looping shapes behind it as it moves.

prompts.name: Versewhirl
prompts.prompt: Its mantle has darkened to a rich indigo-violet with faint glowing dot-patterns, tentacles now curling into deliberate, elegant script-like shapes.

prompts.name: Sonnetide
prompts.prompt: A stately deep-violet ink dancer, tentacles trailing in long ribboned arcs, its dot-markings now glowing soft lilac like scattered stars.

prompts.name: Inkmuse
prompts.prompt: A magnificent violet-black muse crowned in glowing lilac ink-patterns, its many tentacles sweeping in a slow, hypnotic, poem-like flourish.

prompts.name: Fawnlet
prompts.prompt: A small dappled fawn in warm honey-brown with soft cream spots like scattered sunlight, tiny velvet nubs just starting to bud into antlers.

prompts.name: Mossbuck
prompts.prompt: A tall moss-and-antler stag with sprawling branch-like antlers draped in ferns, tiny mushrooms and white flowers, glowing leaf-shaped eye markings down its flank, golden-brown fur fading to a cream belly.

prompts.name: Thicketbuck
prompts.prompt: An even broader stag whose antlers have grown a second tangle of living thicket, deeper moss-green fur now shot through with the same glowing leaf markings, more mushrooms clustered at the base of each antler.

prompts.name: Grovemonarch
prompts.prompt: A towering forest monarch whose antlers form a near-complete canopy of branches, leaves and hanging vines, its glowing leaf-markings now a steady soft light along its spine, deep mossy green fur with a rich cream mane.

prompts.name: Canopyheart
prompts.prompt: A majestic elder stag whose full canopy-antlers shelter small glowing motes of golden light like fireflies, its deep forest-green coat crowned in a rich cream mane, every glowing leaf-mark blazing gently gold.

prompts.name: Bramblewolf
prompts.prompt: A lean grey-green wolf bristling with small thorny brambles along its back and tail, sharp amber eyes, a low predatory crouch.

prompts.name: Thornfang
prompts.prompt: A larger, darker wolf whose thorn-bramble mane has thickened into a spiked ruff, faint yellow-green glow along its markings, ivory horns curving back from its brow.

prompts.name: Bristlemane
prompts.prompt: An even broader wolf with a full bristling mane of interlaced thorn-branches, its glow-markings brighter, deep near-black green fur rippling with muscle.

prompts.name: Duskbramble
prompts.prompt: A towering alpha wolf wreathed in thick brambles down its spine and tail, its horns longer and darker, glow-markings pulsing steadily like embers in undergrowth.

prompts.name: Nightbriar
prompts.prompt: A colossal apex wolf, its whole spine a crown of interlocking thorns, near-black fur seeming to drink the light except for its brilliant glowing green-gold markings.

prompts.name: Lanternfox
prompts.prompt: A slim violet fox with a flame-orange tail-tip that flickers like a lantern wick, warm amber eyes, faint ember sparks drifting from its fur.

prompts.name: Brandfox
prompts.prompt: A taller violet-plum fox whose whole tail now burns steady orange like a carried torch, deeper purple fur along its spine with more visible ember-sparks.

prompts.name: Pyrevane
prompts.prompt: A lean, elegant fox in deep violet-black fur, its tail split into twin torch-flames of hot orange, ears rimmed in glowing embers.

prompts.name: Beaconpyre
prompts.prompt: A striking near-black fox whose entire back bears a low steady flame-crest running from head to tail, brilliant orange glow pooling at every joint.

prompts.name: Beaconsire
prompts.prompt: A magnificent obsidian-violet fox crowned in a mane of true fire, its tail a blazing beacon-flame, glowing orange runes flickering faintly across its coat.

prompts.name: Hootsage
prompts.prompt: A round, softly feathered brown owl with oversized golden eyes and a ruff of feathers like a scholar's collar, a small scroll-like curl of feather at its chest.

prompts.name: Lorewing
prompts.prompt: A larger owl with a fuller feathered collar and longer wing-feathers fanned like open book pages, its golden eyes sharper, deepening brown plumage.

prompts.name: Duskscholar
prompts.prompt: A stately indigo-tinged owl with an elaborate ruff resembling stacked scrolls, its wings edged in a soft moonlit blue glow, deep gold eyes half-lidded in thought.

prompts.name: Archowl
prompts.prompt: A grand indigo-blue owl with a crown-like tuft of feathers and wide ceremonial wings patterned like open manuscripts, faint blue glow tracing every flight feather.

prompts.name: Archsage
prompts.prompt: A magnificent deep indigo owl robed in vast wing-plumage like a scholar's ceremonial cloak, crowned in luminous pale-blue glowing feather-script down each wing.

prompts.name: Mosshulk
prompts.prompt: A hulking grey stone golem shape overgrown with thick moss and a crown of small mushrooms, deep-set glowing eyes, ancient and immovable.

prompts.name: Cairnback
prompts.prompt: A broader moss-stone golem with small balanced cairn-stones stacked along its shoulders, thicker moss coat, softly glowing eye-sockets.

prompts.name: Boulderoot
prompts.prompt: A massive golem whose stone body is threaded through with thick tree-roots, moss and small ferns filling every crack, its glow deepening to a warm gold.

prompts.name: Mossmonolith
prompts.prompt: An enormous standing-stone golem, root-veined and moss-draped from crown to foot, faint golden light glowing in the deepest cracks of its mossy hide.

prompts.name: Cairnsovereign
prompts.prompt: A towering ancient monolith wrapped floor to crown in thick roots, deep moss and small glowing flowers, warm golden light pulsing steadily through every seam like a slow heartbeat.
